title: When the crowd gets quiet, God gets loud. 🗣️🔊
paragraphs: When the crowd gets quiet, God gets loud. 🗣️🔊

It’s easy for people to clap when it’s their moment, but the true test of faith is staying the course when you feel like you're walking alone. Don't let their silence shake your spirit. You aren't performing for their applause; you are fighting for His glory. Keep your eyes on the King. 🙏⚔️
"But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength..." - 2 Timothy 4:17 📖
